address_model.channel_numbering: 1..16 human; MIDI status low nibble is channel-1
address_model.selectors: Explicit input-source-owned pattern/part/kit/drum/bass/strip/step/block/lane/seed-byte selectors. Never UI focus. Reset selectors on input disconnect/replacement. Split low/high selectors commit only on explicit target-confirm barrier.
address_model.version_policy: IDs and occupied addresses immutable after adoption; new entries use holes/new version. Reordering source descriptors requires explicit identity migration.
address_model.optional_14bit: Only registered coarse CC0..31; CC32..63 reserved companions. Every field has an ordinary direct CC7 address, which can quantize wide ranges. Exact canonical integers use the additional explicit selector/value transaction below, never NRPN-only.
address_model.exact_values: selector.parameter_low/high identify immutable parameter_number (7-bit chunks); selector.commit freezes complete context. value.exact_low7/mid7/high7 stages a 21-bit unsigned canonical value; value.exact_commit applies atomically. Old exact_high2 remains a compatible 16-bit high chunk. Reject incomplete/stale transactions. All four seed bytes separately addressable. Browser source BPM milli fits 21 bits; its browser setter remains unimplemented. This extra protocol uses ordinary CCs, not NRPN.
address_model.feedback: No MIDI echo; browser snapshots separate from outbound MIDI. Explicit feedback opt-in needs independent routing/loop tests.
address_model.overflow: Bounded ingress/coalescing for values, ordering barriers for selectors/actions; priority/reserve for Note-Off/Stop/clock; observable rejection/drop counters, never blocking audio.
